quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

endpoints.note: An exact reference in the ApplicationNumber field redirects straight to the detail page, so no separate detail-page fetch is needed here.

source_notes:
Paired ASP.NET anti-forgery token: use the __RequestVerificationToken cookie AND the hidden form-field token from the homepage, together, on one cookie jar. Exact application number in ApplicationNumber field redirects straight to the detail page. Document links live at /Document/Download?module=PLA&recordNumber=<internalId>&planId=..&imageId=..&isPlan=..&fileName=.. ; recordNumber is the internal application id.

Shared product — DEF Software Atrium (same forms/endpoints as Somerset). See the def-atrium vendor entry; Recipe A is its recipe.
